The '''YV-666 light freighter''', also known simply as the '''YV-series freighter''', '''YV-series light freighter''', or '''YV-666''', was a model of [[light freighter]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="Ezra's Gamble" /> A modified YV-series known as the ''[[Hound's Tooth]]'' was used by the [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]].<ref name="SWE" /> 

During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Phindian]] criminal [[Moralo Eval]] purchased the [[Moralo Eval's YV-666 light freighter|one ship]] from a [[Bith]] [[starship]] dealer on [[Nal Hutta]]. Unknown to both [[Cad Bane]] and Eval, [[Rako Hardeen]]; really [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise; placed a [[homing beacon]] on the ship, which lead some [[HH-87 Starhopper]] [[starfighter]]s to shoot the ship down.<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>
